'''Shurr''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with fourteen [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. It held the seventh [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kashyyyk (star)/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Shurr and its star were located within the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], a part of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] positioned in the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]], in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Kashyyyk [[Star system/Legends|system]], and by extension Shurr, rested on the intersection of several [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. These included the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]], which connected Shurr to the [[Balamak system/Legends|Balamak system]] and the [[Torn Station system/Legends|system]] containing [[Torn Station]], while the [[Randon Run/Legends|Randon Run]] linked the planet to the [[Uyter system/Legends|Uyter]] and the [[Rakhuuun system/Legends|Rakhuuun systems]]. Shurr was also connected to the [[Kwookrrr system/Legends|Kwookrrr]] and [[Tholatin system/Legends|Tholatin systems]] by the [[Durkteel Loop/Legends|Durkteel Loop]] and the [[Nightroad/Legends|Nightroad]] hyperlanes, respectively.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shurr was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the Kashyyyk system, and therefore Shurr, in grid square P-9.<ref name="TEA" />
